arguments.value: StartEngine Crowdfunding, Inc. and Solutions Vending International, Inc. agree that StartEngine will provide an online platform for Solutions Vending International, Inc.’s securities offering, including user accounts, offering information, indications of interest, and online subscription and payment submission. In return, Solutions Vending International, Inc. must pay monthly service fees, transaction fees, AML fees, and reimburse related processing, escrow, credit card, and reversal expenses. Solutions Vending International, Inc. is responsible for user activity and any ACH returns, chargebacks, or reversals, and StartEngine may collect those amounts from escrow or directly from Solutions Vending International, Inc.’s bank account. The agreement lasts for the duration of the offering unless ended earlier, and either party may terminate it for uncured breach, misrepresentation, bankruptcy or insolvency, certain legal or regulatory changes, material financial deterioration, or force majeure lasting more than 10 business days. The source does not state a governing law.
